label: Population by region, observations and year
note: Heby municipality changed county affiliation from Uppsala to Västmanland in 2007-01-01. In this table Heby municipality have the current municipal code 0331.

Population during the period 1968–1982 is presented according to the regional division as of January 1, 1983. Adjustments to reflect this regional division have been made using parish division, but not on real estate level, which means that there may be gaps in the statistics. Population in 1983 and onwards is reported according to the regional division on January 1 of the following year.  
Population growth for the period 1968–2009 is defined in this table as the difference between the population at the beginning of the year and the end of the year. Population growth since 2010 is reported according to the division into administrative areas that was in effect on January 1 of the current year.

Registered partnerships regulated couple relationships among persons of the same sex and existed from 1995 to 2009. Registered partners are counted as Married, Separated partners as Divorced and Surviving partners as Widows/widowers.
The period 1968–1998 is reported according to the regional divisions that applied on 01-01-1998.
